name: Plan Comparison Table
hint: Flip Monthly / Yearly and watch every price roll. Turn on Show differences only, then scroll: the plan header condenses into a sticky bar.
description: The detailed feature-by-plan table that sits below the pricing cards, for any number of plans and your own feature rows (the sample content is Quire, a docs and wiki tool: Free, Plus, Business and Enterprise across 28 features in six groups), with checks and dashes (with screen-reader text), limits, values, add-ons, roadmap items and footnote tooltips. The billing toggle (a measured segmented control with a Save 20% badge) rolls every price digit by digit and rewrites the yearly note; Show differences only folds the identical rows away with a height spring while each group's count rolls; a spring band follows the column under the pointer or keyboard focus across a soft accent wash on the recommended plan. When the plan header scrolls away, a condensed bar with name, price and CTA scrubs in at the top of the scroller and back out at the top. Collapsed groups keep a per-plan coverage meter. ARIA table semantics with plans as column headers and features as row headers. Under 720px it re-composes into a two-plan comparison: a chip rail with a two-wide pill picks the adjacent pair, or swipe the table sideways.
intents: compare pricing plans feature by feature
plan comparison table below pricing cards
feature matrix with sticky plan header
monthly yearly toggle that updates every plan price
usage: Put it under the pricing cards on a pricing page, for readers who want every line item. It shows only what you pass: no `plans` renders nothing, and `demo` fills the blanks with a sample docs tool. Pass your own `plans` (columns) and `groups` (sections of rows, each row with one value per plan), plus `currencies`, `unit`, `eyebrow`, `subtitle` and `footnote`; set `recommended` and `currency` to your own ids and codes. Prices come from each plan's `price`, so they stay in step with the billing toggle. Keep plans to four or fewer columns; group features into five to eight groups and footnote only the rows support gets asked about. Pass stickyOffset when the page has a fixed navbar so the condensed bar sits below it. For choosing a single plan by seats or usage, use Odometer Pricing instead. On a page with Pricing Table, keep one billing period: pass the same `billing` and `onBillingChange` to both, or set `showBilling={false}` here. Prices print as in Pricing Table (whole amounts bare, otherwise to the cent). Under a Navbar, feed its `onOffsetChange` into `stickyOffset`. `onSelectPlan(id, billing, plan)` acts on a plan button; set `loadingPlan` to that id while checkout starts. Amounts print through `formatPrice(amount, { currency, symbol })` and fixed words through `labels`.

dataProps.description: The billing period, controlled when passed with `onBillingChange`. Passed alone (the older use, and the way to follow Pricing Table with showBilling={false}) it sets the prices and follows the prop when it changes.
"Show differences only", controlled when passed with `onDifferencesOnlyChange`; passed alone it sets the switch and follows the prop.
(on: boolean) => void when the reader flips "Show differences only".
Ids of the open feature groups, controlled when passed with `onOpenGroupsChange`. Groups without an id get g0, g1…
Uncontrolled starting set of open groups. Default: every group open.
(ids: string[]) => void when a group opens or closes, or on Expand all / Collapse all.

The columns, in order: [{ id, name, tag, cta, short?, price, note?, priceLabel? }]. price: 0 = free, null = custom (shows priceLabel or "Custom"), a monthly number (yearly is derived from yearlyDiscount), [monthly, yearly], or either keyed by currency code ({ USD: 9, EUR: 9 }). note: the two small lines under the price, [line, line]; paid plans get them worked out when omitted. short: the label in the condensed sticky bar. Empty by default (nothing renders); `demo` shows the Quire sample.

Sections of rows: [{ id?, name, icon?, rows: [{ id?, label, note?, v: [one value per plan] }] }]. A value is true (check), false (dash), text, { t, s } (value with a small line), { soon: true } (Coming soon) or { addon: true } (Add-on pill; add `s` for your own small line, or a number / per-currency object as its price). `note` adds a footnote tooltip. Empty by default.
[{ code, symbol }]. `currency` picks one by code (else the first). The symbol is printed before amounts unless you pass `formatPrice`. Empty by default (amounts print bare).

Fraction taken off for yearly billing when a price gives only the monthly figure. The "Save N%" badge is worked out from the resulting prices (the best saving across plans), so it always agrees with them.
What a price is per, in "per seat / month". Default "seat" ("member" in the demo).
Price printed under { addon: true } cells, a number or keyed by currency code. null (the default) prints none.
Small line above the title. Empty by default.
Paragraph under the title. Empty by default.
Small print under the table. Empty by default.
Pixels to leave above the condensed bar, for a fixed navbar.
(planId, billing, plan) => void when a plan button is pressed: the id, "annual" or "monthly", and the plan object you passed. Not called while `disabled` or while `loadingPlan` is set.
(billing: "annual" | "monthly") => void when the reader flips the switch. With `billing` it makes the switch controlled: share one state with Pricing Table.
The Monthly / Yearly switch. Set false when another component on the page (Pricing Table) owns it; `billing` still drives the prices.
Badge over the recommended column. Match it to Pricing Table's badge.

(amount: number, { currency, symbol }) => string. Prints every amount: column prices, the sticky bar, the yearly maths and add-on prices. Default: the currency's symbol, then the number with whole amounts bare and others to the cent.

Replaces the fixed words: { billingPeriod, monthly, annual, save: (n) => string, differencesOnly, expandAll, collapseAll, billedYearly, billedMonthly, perMonth, pricesIn: (code) => string, soon, addon, included, notIncluded, custom, choose, feature, pairs, swipe }. Pass only the keys you change.
Id of the plan whose checkout is running: its buttons show a spinner and no plan button fires until you set it back to null.
The root <section>.

example:
<PlanComparison
  title="Compare plans"
  eyebrow="Relay plans"
  subtitle="Prices are per seat, before tax."
  footnote="Switching plans is prorated to the day."
  unit="seat"
  currency="USD"
  currencies={[{ code: "USD", symbol: "$" }]}
  recommended="team"
  plans={[
    { id: "free", name: "Free", tag: "For trying Relay", cta: "Start free", price: 0, note: ["up to 3 seats", "No card needed"] },
    { id: "team", name: "Team", tag: "For growing teams", cta: "Start trial", price: 9 },
    { id: "business", name: "Business", tag: "For support orgs", cta: "Start trial", price: 19 },
  ]}
  groups={[
    { name: "Inbox", icon: "message", rows: [
      { label: "Shared inboxes", v: ["1", "5", "Unlimited"] },
      { label: "Automations", note: "Rules that route and tag mail.", v: [false, true, true] },
      { label: "AI replies", v: [false, { addon: true, s: "$4 / seat / mo" }, true] },
    ] },
  ]}
  billing={billing}
  onBillingChange={setBilling}
  loadingPlan={checkingOut}
  onSelectPlan={(id, billing) => startCheckout(id, billing)}
/>
